meta.description: Registry for recursive transport-closure classes and iteration conditions in Phase 3.

transport_closure_classes.meaning: Transport remains closed within a fixed, finite number of steps.
Transport remains restricted to and closed within bounded/local admissibility neighborhoods.
Transport may connect distant loci but closure is preserved under explicit global constraints.
Closure is maintained only if specific residue, orientation, and pruning conditions are satisfied per iteration.
Transport closure degrades under long-term iteration, resulting in admissibility leakage.
The transport operator permits states to map outside all declared admissible domains.
Closure status for the recursive transport system has not been established.

conditions: transport path remains inside declared local admissibility neighborhood
residue and orientation drift remain bounded
CSI contribution is finite or effectively truncated
transport path remains within declared bounded nonlocal domain
transport leakage failure modes remain active
orientation drift remains within minimization tolerance
residue balance remains bounded or saturating
global infinite-recursion transport closure is not proven
